description: This file implements a tool for editing files with support for fast apply edits via external APIs like Morph, KiloCode, and OpenRouter. It includes functions for cost calculation, parameter validation, applying fast apply edits, and managing user interactions and contribution tracking.

classes.name: MorphApplyResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a fast apply edit attempt, including success status, resulting code, error message, and usage details.

methods.name: calculateFastApplyCost
methods.description: Calculates the cost of a fast apply edit based on input/output tokens and model.

methods.name: validateParams
methods.description: Validates required parameters for the editFileTool function.

methods.name: editFileTool
methods.description: Main function to handle file editing with support for fast apply, user approval, and contribution tracking.

methods.name: applyFastApplyEdit
methods.description: Performs a fast apply edit via external API, returning the merged code and usage info.

methods.name: getFastApplyConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for fast apply based on current state, including API keys and model info.

methods.name: isFastApplyAvailable
methods.description: Checks if fast apply is available based on current state.

methods.name: getFastApplyModelType
methods.description: Determines whether the fast apply model type is Morph or Relace based on current state.
